title: Characterizations of extremal hyperbolic rates via Herglotz measures and Koenigs linearization
summary: Let $g:\mathbb{D}\to\mathbb{D}$ be a hyperbolic holomorphic self-map of the unit disk with Denjoy--Wolff point $τ\in\partial\mathbb{D}$ and angular derivative $α\in(0,1)$. We say that $g$ has an \textit{extremal hyperbolic rate} if its forward iterates satisfy the sharp metric asymptotic \begin{equation*} ρ_{\mathbb{D}}(g^{\circ n}(z),w) = n\log\frac{1}α + O(1) \quad\text{as }n\to\infty, \end{equation*} for every $z,w\in\mathbb{D}$.
